papers.title: Effects of nitrogen addition on radial growth and wood anatomy of Betula platyphylla with different stem diameters in Dongling Mountain
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现前沿突破；命中“mechanistic”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract Atmospheric nitrogen (N) deposition profoundly influences plant growth in forest ecosystems.
essence.design: Our study demonstrates that nitrogen addition exacerbates size-dependent growth inequalities in temperate forests through earlywood anatomical adjustments, providing a mechanistic basis for understanding how atmospheric nitrogen inputs affect forest stand dynamics.
essence.innovation: While numerous studies have reported the effects of N addition on tree radial growth, the response patterns across trees with different stem diameters and the underlying anatomical mechanisms associated within their wood growth rings remain unclear.
essence.limitations: 以上内容基于公开摘要；样本范围、统计细节与因果边界需阅读全文核验。
